## What it is

A recessed fluorescent troffer for the talk's bright cubicle stage. This is a
render asset, never a printed part. The metal tray is modeled here; the scene
adds one emissive diffuser plane inside its opening so four fixtures share one
instanced housing draw and one instanced diffuser draw.

## Design notes

The diffuser opening is a real recess with an inner wall. A plane placed directly
on the ceiling had no thickness, no rim, and read as a glowing UI rectangle.
Dimensions are deliberately conventional office proportions rather than a brand
match.

## Don't

- Don't add individual tubes. At projector distance they alias and add geometry
  without changing the read; the broad diffuser is the visible object.
- Don't act on printability findings. This asset is never manufactured.
